response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced full-stack and systems software engineer, but his career has centered on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile platforms rather than C++. His only substantive C++ exposure was a brief ~6-month stint in 2014-2015 writing C/C++ components for an IDE and a university thesis project, far short of the 8-12 years of C++ development this role requires. There is no evidence of STL mastery, multi-threading/networking in C++, message brokers, MQTT/REST in an industrial context, UML/architecture documentation, or IEC 62443/SDL security experience, making him a poor match for this specific senior C++ industrial automation role.
strengths: 20+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Experience with distributed/microservices systems, async I/O, and performance-sensitive backend work (in DLang)
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months, over a decade ago), not the 8-12 years required
No demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, Secure Development Lifecycle, or industrial cybersecurity standards
No evidence of MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3, IEC 61850/104), or IoT/industrial automation domain background

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering and architecture skills
